reported_user_failure.cause: The installed CPython product entered Modify with an old nested location registered, while a different new TargetDir was requested. Setup returned success with no core/exe installation action, and the old helper required python.exe at only the new location.
reported_user_failure.access: Diagnosed from user-provided installer log. The user's computer was not accessed or repaired by these tests.
reported_user_failure.remaining_unknown: The supplied installer log alone does not show whether the old python.exe files were missing or an inherited Python environment made the old non-isolated probe fail. Both paths are covered by the fix.
